dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "This was a real gut-buster. Still, why is the loyal servant's title so long?"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "Well, this is a recent fad within the kingdom. Perhaps you, too, might like to grant yourself a title of suitable vibrance, such as..."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "Witness to Phantasmagoria, Grandmaster Fan of the Twilight Theater!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "The hungry dragon was super weak. One's got to wonder if one could beat him with a single strike too, eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "The important thing is to take the first step forward boldly!"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "...And you know, to take care of one's health!"
